Piano Tiles

Piano Tiles — tap only the black tiles as they fall. Speed rises with every tile.

0
Score
0
Best

Tap the black tiles only — don't tap white, don't miss.

📖 How to use

  1. Press “Start” — black tiles fall down 4 lanes.
  2. Tap each black tile before it crosses the bottom.
  3. Never tap white space, and never let a tile escape.
  4. Score = tiles tapped. Chase your best!

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the rules?

Tap a black tile before it reaches the bottom line. Tapping a white (empty) area or letting a black tile slip past ends the game.

Does it speed up?

Every 10 tiles the fall speed increases — it starts gentle and gets seriously fast.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score is saved in your browser.
